"""Independent bounded public-API probes; no source fixtures are executed."""
import asyncio
import json
import platform
import sys
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

from devtools.core.paths import resolve_path
from devtools.core.conversion import convert, convert_all
from devtools.core.time import Timestamp
from devtools.resources.filesystem import (
    BinaryFile, CsvDialect, CsvFile, CsvQuoting, CsvRow, JsonListFile, JsonObjectFile,
    JsonScalarFile, MarkdownFile, TextFile, read, write,
)
from devtools.resources.filesystem.codecs import BinaryCodec, CsvCodec, JsonCodec, MarkdownCodec, TextCodec
from devtools.tools import ToolRunner
from devtools.tools.filesystem import ReadRepositoryFileTool

OUT=Path(__file__).parent
ROWS=[]
def check(name, expected, action, classification='CONTROL', source=None):
    try:
        observed=action()
    except Exception as error:
        observed={'error':type(error).__name__, 'message':str(error)}
    agrees=(observed==expected)
    ROWS.append(dict(name=name,classification=classification,source=source,expected=expected,observed=observed,agrees=agrees))

def exception_name(action):
    try: action()
    except Exception as error: return type(error).__name__
    return 'NO_EXCEPTION'

with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='devtools-codec-audit-') as directory:
    root=Path(directory); p=resolve_path(root/'data.json')
    j=JsonCodec(); c=CsvCodec(); nonnumeric=CsvDialect(quoting=CsvQuoting.NONNUMERIC)
    if '--compat' in sys.argv:
        for name,action in [
            ('json-object-constructor',lambda: type(JsonObjectFile(p,'{}',value={})).__name__),
            ('json-list-constructor',lambda: type(JsonListFile(p,'[]',value=())).__name__),
            ('csv-constructor',lambda: type(CsvFile(p,'id\n',headers=('id',),rows=())).__name__),
            ('json-object-codec',lambda:type(j.parse(p,'{}')).__name__),
            ('json-list-codec',lambda:type(j.parse(p,'[]')).__name__),
            ('csv-codec',lambda:type(c.parse(p,'id\n007\n')).__name__),
        ]:
            expected='CsvFile' if name.startswith('csv') else ('JsonObjectFile' if 'object' in name else 'JsonListFile')
            check(name,expected,action,'EXISTING_B0048')
        check('scalar-codec-control','JsonScalarFile',lambda:type(j.parse(p,'null')).__name__)
        check('markdown-control','MarkdownFile',lambda:type(MarkdownFile(p,'# title\n')).__name__)
        check('text-control','TextFile',lambda:type(TextFile(p,'plain')).__name__)
        check('binary-control','BinaryFile',lambda:type(BinaryFile(p,b'\x00')).__name__)
        (root/'object.json').write_text('{}',encoding='utf-8')
        check('public-read-object','JsonObjectFile',lambda:type(read(resolve_path(root/'object.json'))).__name__,'EXISTING_B0048')
        async def tool_read():
            result=await ToolRunner().execute(ReadRepositoryFileTool(resolve_path(root)),resolve_path(root/'object.json'))
            return type(result).__name__
        check('toolrunner-object','JsonObjectFile',lambda:asyncio.run(tool_read()),'EXISTING_B0048')
    else:
        for label,source,expected,dialect in [
            ('simple','"id","name"\n1,"Ada"\n',['1','Ada'],nonnumeric),
            ('zeroes','"id","value"\n001,1.50\n',['001','1.50'],nonnumeric),
            ('exponent','"id","value"\n1e2,-0\n',['1e2','-0'],nonnumeric),
            ('semicolon','"id";"value"\n007;"x;y"\n',['007','x;y'],CsvDialect(delimiter=';',quoting=CsvQuoting.NONNUMERIC)),
        ]:
            check('csv-nonnumeric-'+label,expected,lambda s=source,d=dialect:list(c.parse(p,s,dialect=d).rows[0].cells),'EXISTING_CSV_PROPOSAL',source)
        check('csv-decode-nonnumeric',['001','1.50'],lambda:list(c.decode(p,b'"id","value"\n001,1.50\n',dialect=nonnumeric).rows[0].cells),'EXISTING_CSV_PROPOSAL')
        check('csv-numeric-string-headers',[['1','2'],['3','4']],lambda:(lambda file:[list(file.headers),list(file.rows[0].cells)])(c.parse(p,'1,2\n3,4\n',dialect=nonnumeric)),'EXISTING_CSV_PROPOSAL','1,2\n3,4\n')
        check('csv-quoted-control',['001','1.50'],lambda:list(c.parse(p,'"id","value"\n"001","1.50"\n',dialect=nonnumeric).rows[0].cells))
        check('csv-minimal-control',['001','1.50'],lambda:list(c.parse(p,'id,value\n001,1.50\n').rows[0].cells))
        check('csv-crlf-quoted-newline',['a\r\nb','x,y'],lambda:list(c.parse(p,'id,value\r\n"a\r\nb","x,y"\r\n').rows[0].cells))
        check('csv-ragged-refusal','FileFormatError',lambda:exception_name(lambda:c.parse(p,'id,value\nonly\n')))
        check('csv-duplicate-header-refusal','FileFormatError',lambda:exception_name(lambda:c.parse(p,'id,id\nx,y\n')))
        def csv_changed():
            changed=c.parse(p,'id\n001\n').with_row(0,CsvRow(('id',),('002',)))
            return [changed.content,c.serialize(changed)]
        check('csv-source-versus-state',['id\n001\n','id\n002\n'],csv_changed)
        cases=[('missing-versus-null','[{"tag":"missing"},{"tag":"present","key":null}]',None,'present'),
               ('list-query','[{"tag":"array","key":[1,2]}]',[1,2],'array'),
               ('nested-query','[{"tag":"nested","key":{"items":[1]}}]',{'items':[1]},'nested')]
        for label,source,query,expected in cases:
            def find(source=source,query=query):
                result=j.parse(p,source).find_by('key',query)
                return None if result is None else result['tag']
            check('json-find-'+label,expected,find,'NEW_JSON_MEMBER_LOOKUP',source)
        check('json-find-scalar-control','present',lambda:j.parse(p,'[{"key":7,"tag":"present"}]').find_by('key',7)['tag'])
        check('json-find-missing-control',None,lambda:j.parse(p,'[{"key":8}]').find_by('key',7))
        for source in ['NaN','Infinity','1e999','{"x":}']:
            check('json-invalid-'+source,'FileFormatError',lambda s=source:exception_name(lambda:j.parse(p,s)))
        check('json-duplicate-last-wins',2,lambda:j.parse(p,'{"x":1,"x":2}').value['x'],'DOCUMENTED_OR_STDLIB_LIMITATION')
        check('json-source-current-state-separation',['{"x": 1}',2],lambda:(lambda f:[f.content,f.with_item('x',2).value['x']])(j.parse(p,'{"x": 1}')))
        original={'items':[1]}
        model=JsonObjectFile(p,'source',value=original);original['items'].append(2)
        check('json-input-alias-isolation',[1],lambda:list(model.value['items']))
        def assign(): model.value['x']=2
        check('json-immutable-object','TypeError',lambda:exception_name(assign))
        check('json-thaw-independent',[1],lambda:(lambda mutable:(mutable['items'].append(9),list(model.value['items']))[1])(model.convert(lambda value:value)))
        def conversion_failure():
            visited=[]
            def converter(value):
                visited.append(value)
                return int(value)
            try: convert_all(['1','bad','3'],converter)
            except Exception as error:
                return [type(error).__name__,type(error.__cause__).__name__,type(error.__cause__.__cause__).__name__,visited]
            return 'NO_EXCEPTION'
        check('conversion-fail-fast-cause',['ConversionError','ConversionError','ValueError',['1','bad']],conversion_failure)
        check('conversion-success-order',[2,3],lambda:list(convert_all([1,2],lambda value:value+1)))
        check('json-float-normalization',1.5,lambda:j.parse(p,'1.50').value,'DOCUMENTED_OR_STDLIB_LIMITATION')
        raw=b'\x00\xff\r\n'
        check('binary-exact',raw.hex(),lambda:BinaryCodec().encode(BinaryCodec().decode(p,raw)).hex())
        text='\ufeffpi=π\r\n\x00\n'
        check('text-utf8-exact',text,lambda:TextCodec().decode(p,TextCodec().encode(TextFile(p,text))).content)
        check('text-invalid-utf8','TextDecodingError',lambda:exception_name(lambda:TextCodec().decode(p,b'\xff')))
        markdown='# title\r\n```\r\n# hidden\r\n```\r\n## child\r\nbody\r\n'
        md=MarkdownCodec().decode(p,markdown.encode())
        check('markdown-source-exact',markdown,lambda:MarkdownCodec().encode(md).decode())
        check('markdown-headings-fence',['title','child'],lambda:[h.text for h in md.headings])
        check('markdown-logical-sections-no-cr',True,lambda:all('\r' not in s.content for s in md.sections),'DOCUMENTED_OR_STDLIB_LIMITATION')
        target=resolve_path(root/'plain.txt');write(TextFile(target,text));check('public-text-read-write',text,lambda:read(target).content)
        (root/'items.json').write_text('[{}, {"key":null,"tag":"present"}]',encoding='utf-8')
        async def tool_find():
            result=await ToolRunner().execute(ReadRepositoryFileTool(resolve_path(root)),resolve_path(root/'items.json'))
            match=result.find_by('key',None)
            return None if match is None else dict(match)
        check('toolrunner-rich-json-member',{'key':None,'tag':'present'},lambda:asyncio.run(tool_find()),'NEW_JSON_MEMBER_LOOKUP')

value=dict(at=str(Timestamp.now()),python=sys.version,platform=platform.platform(),mode='compat' if '--compat' in sys.argv else 'representation',rows=ROWS,
           unexpected_control_failures=[r['name'] for r in ROWS if not r['agrees'] and r['classification'] in ['CONTROL','DOCUMENTED_OR_STDLIB_LIMITATION']])
name='compat-'+str(sys.version_info.minor)+'.json' if '--compat' in sys.argv else 'probes.json'
(OUT/name).write_text(json.dumps(value,indent=2,ensure_ascii=False)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps(dict(output=name,cases=len(ROWS),mismatches=[r['name'] for r in ROWS if not r['agrees']],unexpected_control_failures=value['unexpected_control_failures']),indent=2))
if value['unexpected_control_failures']:sys.exit(1)

"""Use the existing Python 3.12 interpreter without installing any environment."""
import asyncio, hashlib, json
from pathlib import Path
from devtools.core.paths import resolve_path
from devtools.core.time import Timestamp, Stopwatch
from devtools.resources.commands import Command,CommandExecutor,CommandOutputPolicy
R=Path.cwd();O=Path(__file__).parent
async def main():
    executable=Path('C:/Users/recoveryadmin/AppData/Roaming/uv/python/cpython-3.12.13-windows-x86_64-none/python.exe')
    assert executable.is_file()
    timer=Stopwatch();start=str(Timestamp.now())
    result=await CommandExecutor(output_policy=CommandOutputPolicy(max_stdout_bytes=1<<20,max_stderr_bytes=1<<20)).execute(
        Command(str(executable)).args('-B',str(O/'probes.py'),'--compat').cwd(resolve_path(R)).with_environment({'PYTHONPATH':str(R/'src'),'PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE':'1'}))
    timer.stop()
    (O/'compatibility-execution.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(at=start,executable=str(executable),executable_sha256=hashlib.sha256(executable.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),exit_code=result.exit_code,elapsed_seconds=timer.elapsed.total_seconds,stdout=result.stdout.decode(),stderr=result.stderr.decode(),environment='Only child PYTHONPATH=canonical/src and PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1; existing interpreter; no installs or dependency sharing.'),indent=2)+'\n')
    print(result.stdout.decode());assert not result.failed,result.stderr
asyncio.run(main())
